event_day_semantics.admitted: Non-deferred decisions recorded on that event day.
event_day_semantics.day: Simulator-relative event day, not a calendar date.
event_day_semantics.ending_backlog: Prior ending backlog + admitted - inspection attempts.
event_day_semantics.inspection_attempts: Recorded simulated inspection outcomes on that event day.
event_day_semantics.intra_day_max_note: Not exported: day-level records have no within-day event order, so an exact intra-day maximum would be invented.

scope.ci_interpretation: 95% bootstrap intervals across declared simulation seeds only.
limitations: Simulator outcomes are counterfactual and do not establish causal dispatch effects.
The 782-record AHV cohort contains only 16 administrative actionable labels; this is a small simulator-policy study, not a predictive-performance headline.
Borough slices are operational geography metrics, not demographic fairness measures or proxies.
